description: Today, the Missouri-Kansas-Nebraska Conference of Teamsters endorsed Cindy Holscher for governor, adding to the growing coalition behind her campaign. The Teamsters represent more than 6,000 working men and women across Kansas, in areas as diverse as freight distribution, car-haul, heavy highway construction, wholesale and retail food distribution, small parcel and package delivery, brewery and soda manufacturing, railroad and maintenance of way workers, school bus drivers, and many of Kansas’ transportation industries.

title: Missouri-Kansas-Nebraska Conference of Teamsters Endorses Cindy Holscher for Governor | Cindy Holscher for Governor
